AI is moving from experimentation into production, and this role is an opportunity to break into AI while doing meaningful enterprise selling. As an Account Executive, AI Hunter, your job is simple: create new SingleStore customers. You will find companies building AI applications where data access, real-time context, memory, retrieval, or operational scale is becoming a constraint—and turn those challenges into new SingleStore customers. You will own a broad territory, build a majority self-sourced pipeline, create demand in an emerging category, and close greenfield enterprise opportunities. This is a true hunting role. You will engage customers before they have a defined project, develop customer-specific points of view, create urgency around business and technical problems, work with technical experts to land first production workloads, and build a measurable new-logo business with broad ownership. The ideal candidate is a measurable enterprise hunter who is competitive, curious, technically credible, resilient, and able to sell business outcomes. Direct AI sales experience is valuable, but proven selling ability and technical curiosity matter more than a narrow “AI seller” title. Role and Responsibilities Build and execute a territory strategy for net-new customer acquisition. Prospect fearlessly across a broad account universe using proactive, persistent outbound, account-based, partne

jobs.title: MIT- Software Engineer Intern | Engine
jobs.description_text: Position Overview As a Software Engineer, Intern, you'll have the opportunity to spend 12 weeks working on one (or more) of the engineering teams at SingleStore. You will be at the forefront of real-time technology that’s revolutionizing how companies run their businesses every day. With a continuous release cycle, our engineers are accustomed to moving quickly in a rapid production environment. To do this successfully, we work collaboratively and creatively across teams to maximize our opportunity for impact. We also believe it’s important to celebrate our wins together, whether it be at a local spot or getting out of the city for some exploring. As a Software Engineer, Intern, you will be empowered to own your projects end-to-end and be an active contributor throughout the product life cycle. To expedite your growth path, you will partner with engineers who deeply care about your success and will lend their expertise to your professional development. Our engineers are not just technical partners/mentors, but are also business partners who are exposed to all areas of the business, working with teams such as product, marketing, and sales. Our interns are responsible for projects that are deployed continuously into production over the course of their internship. Your work will include everything from writing new features to testing software and you’ll gain a significant understanding of both the product and the business. Required Skills and Experience Enrolled in a B.S. Degree

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description_text: About SingleStore SingleStore delivers a real-time, distributed SQL database that unifies transactional and analytical workloads. Our engineers build cloud-native software for some of the world’s most demanding data-intensive applications, working in a fast-moving environment where teams own their work end to end and partner closely across Product and customer-facing organizations. About the Flow team SingleStore Flow is an enterprise data migration and integration product that helps customers move data into SingleStore reliably and at scale. The team builds the systems that support schema transfer, bulk data loading, real-time Change Data Capture (CDC), large-table migrations, and a native experience in SingleStore Helios. Flow spans Java-based engines, source and destination connectors, database internals, performance and memory management, Helios services and APIs, observability, test automation, Flow AI Agent and signed production release delivery. The product works across heterogeneous database environments, including MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, MongoDB, SAP HANA, Snowflake, Salesforce, and SingleStore-as-a-source. Position Overview We are looking for a Staff Engineer to provide technical leadership for Flow’s end-to-end data path from source systems and CDC through migration engines, APIs, Helios, and the customer experience. You will own the development, testing, and integration of advanced avionics and electromechanical systems. You'll design and debug circuits and subsystems, lead hands-on assembly, troubleshooting, and testing, and drive system-level design verification and qualification efforts. This is a full time onsite position based out of our systems integration lab in El Segundo, CA. Develop and implement design changes to PCBAs, and lead detailed failure analysis and root cause investigations at the board and subsystem level. Design, fabricate, test, and validate complex wire harnesses and assemblies, including connector selection and installation. Author, maintain, and execute test and acceptance procedures for system validation and certification. Plan and conduct board-level and system-level testing, analyze test data, and present findings and recommendations to engineering teams. Oversee calibration, configuration control, and testing of electronic equipment within the lab environment to ensure accurate performance and compliance with design standards. Diagnose failures to root cause with oscilloscopes and DMMs, then document findings and corrective action. Work from schematics, wire lists, and interconnect drawings; red-line them and report discrepancies to engineering. Analyze test data and recommend changes to components, harness design, or test procedures. jobs.title: Unit 26 - Software & System Architect Opportunities
jobs.description_text: Build the 26th We promise the world 25 new products a year. Unit 26 builds the 26th: SharkNinja itself. Inside a company moving as fast as ours, the highest-impact work doesn’t always fit neatly into anyone’s job description. It sits between functions and stays unsolved until someone owns it completely, builds the solution, proves its value, and ships it. That’s where Unit 26 comes in. Unit 26 is a small team of builders reporting to the Chief of Staff to the CEO, with executive sponsorship and access to the C-suite from day one. Our job is to solve problems that don’t have an obvious owner or an existing solution. When your build ships, you hand it to the business unit waiting on the other side and move to the next one. Zero to one, again and again. We’re starting with just eight builders, from inside SharkNinja and out. The Role You’ll work directly with teams across SharkNinja to understand what needs to change and what a successful solution must deliver. Then you own the build. What you make will flex with the problem: an app, an algorithm, an AI agent that eliminates thousands of hours of manual work, or a system that doesn’t yet exist at SharkNinja, or anywhere else. Some of your work will change how we run the company. Some will end up inside our products. Some will be things we haven’t imagined yet. Here, the building comes first. You’ll build on top of a global innovation engine that reaches tens of millions of homes, and you’ll have a stake in the value you create.
